details: Attendance at Helsinki without Nazis counterdemonstration is well above 50, but reviewed sources frame it as opposing 612 march and do not evidence a Finnish government demand. Counts/scopes differ. Police/arrest response cannot be assigned to each group.

State-policy demands are explicit in organizer pages, but actual execution and local simultaneous attendance are unverified. Search result for Yle on 15 Dec appears to concern a distinct eastern-border event in Lappeenranta/Helsinki; body was not accessed.

Organizer search result and Flickr page describe planned event and Finland-directed arms-trade demand; Sumud body request redirected and Flickr photo itself was not inspected. Occurrence and threshold unresolved.

Search scope emphasized Helsinki, Yle, Finnish/English queries and known Palestine/culture/Independence Day events. Regional outlets, labor/social policy sectors, and event-by-event verification remain incomplete. This is not exhaustive and absence in searches is not a zero-event finding.
